findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed bar soda gun to be soiled with black mold. Discussed with PIC, soda gun was cleaned with sanitizer solution. Ensure soda guns are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents black mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed plates to not be inverted in kitchen. Discussed with PIC, plates were inverted. Ensure when stored plates are kept inverted to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(B) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (B) Clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be stored: (1) In a self-draining position that allows air drying; and (2) Covered or inverted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following non food contact areas to be soiled with food splash/debris:
1) (Repeat) Microwave above pizza prep cooler. 
2) Top of dish machine. 

Discussed with PIC, the following areas will be cleaned. Ensure non-food contact areas are being kept at a frequency that prevents food splash/debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed the caulking at the back kitchen hand sinks to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be cleaned and replaced. Ensure staff is monitoring and replacing caulking throughout facility regularly.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
